data.one_liner: A multiple selection widget with fuzzy search functionality.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable multiple selection widget featuring built-in fuzzy search capabilities and various item visibility modes. It allows users to search, select, create, and manage multiple items within a Flutter application.
use_when: You need a picker or selector UI that supports multiple item selection.
Users need to quickly filter large lists using fuzzy search.
You want support for creating new items on the fly when search returns no matches.
avoid_when: Your app still uses package:flutter/material.dart and you cannot migrate to material_ui.
You only require a simple single-selection dropdown or picker.
strengths: Built-in fuzzy search support with multiple search algorithms.
Highly customizable with builders for items, picked items, and created items.
Supports creating new items dynamically when search results are empty.
weaknesses: Requires migration to the standalone material_ui package in version 3.0.0.
High Dart and Flutter SDK minimum version requirements.
data.setup_notes: Requires running flutter pub add material_ui and dart fix during migration to version 3.0.0.
